user.title: Dew point
user.description: Choose how dew point sensors are created.

menu_options.auto: Automatic detection: one sensor on every device that measures both temperature and humidity
menu_options.manual: Manual pair: pick a temperature sensor and a humidity sensor

manual.title: Manual pair
manual.description: Creates a dew point sensor from any two sensors, for example when they belong to different devices. If both sensors are part of the same device, the new sensor is attached to it and its name is prefixed with the device name.

data_description.name: Name of the dew point sensor to create.

error.already_detected: The automatic detection already provides a dew point sensor for these two sensors.
